recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add a single System URL summary row to ValueSet pages because that would conflict with the approved multi-system rationale. If future evidence shows the System column missing for a current build page, fix the expansion renderer/build tooling rather than adding per-ValueSet static source text.
issue_request: FHIR-27122 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. The original request was to re-add the DSTU2-style System URL row to ValueSet documentation pages because users were confused about which Coding.system URL to use. The final decision rejected a single summary System URL because value sets can draw from multiple code systems, and instead required the expansion to show System next to Code for Coding/CodeableConcept uses.
initial_application: No commit in this FHIR checkout explicitly mentions FHIR-27122. The current source path for the seed example is active: source/fhir.ini lists Condition as a current resource, source/condition/valueset-condition-clinical.xml defines the single included system, and tools/templates/template-vs.html delegates expansion rendering to the generated <%vsexpansion%> block rather than hardcoding a System URL summary row.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2021-02-22 record the same rationale and motion: System URL was removed because value sets do not always come from a single code system, and a System column would be added to the expansion table for Coding/CodeableConcept uses. Current build.fhir.org and published R5 pages for valueset-condition-clinical.html show the System column even though the ValueSet source has only one system; the R4 page lacks that column. No directly relevant or conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current built specification already implements the approved behavior: the expansion exposes http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-clinical in a System column beside Code instead of relying on a single System URL row in the summary table.
